match.userMessage:
Use Image 1 as the starting frame.
EXT. DOWNTOWN ROOFTOP — SUNSET. Natural, even lighting. #FFFFFF, #F0E6D3, #D4536D, #1A1A1A, #E8F4E8. Modern social-first product photography with tactile, editorial energy. Products shown in real-life context -- hands opening packaging, fingers pressing textures, products on bathroom shelves, kitchen counters, rumpled linen. Close-up detail shots emphasize material and finish. Flat-lays with curated minimal arrangements. Color-matched backgrounds that complement the product. Every frame feels like something you would screenshot and save, Clean and bright with true-to-life color. Whites are crisp, skin tones warm and natural. Minimal processing -- the product looks like it does in your hand. Slight warmth in highlights, lifted shadows keeping everything airy. One accent color pops against neutral base.

No BGM, no music. Generate only dialogue, environmental sounds, and action sounds.

non_diegetic_music: N/A

Shot 2 (3-6s): Image 3 applies one final swipe of lipstick as Image 2 adjusts her collar and they laugh.. Let the shared laugh feel unforced as the wind lifts their hair.. Camera: playful, quick handheld drift

overall_soundscape: Rooftop wind; distant city traffic.

The video follows a modern, social-first editorial photography style with tactile energy. The color palette is composed of warm sunset tones, creams, deep pinks, and charcoal blacks, with crisp whites and natural, warm skin tones. 
[Shot 1] The scene opens on <Picture 1>, where <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> stand on a concrete downtown rooftop during a vibrant sunset. In the background, the city skyline is bathed in a golden glow. A commuter train rattles across the tracks in the distance. <Subject 2> and <Subject 3> look out over the glowing city with relaxed expressions. The camera uses an easy, energetic handheld drift, capturing the atmosphere of the urban evening. 
[Shot 2] At 00:03.000, the shot cuts to a closer-medium framing. <Subject 3> holds <Subject 4> and applies one final smooth swipe of coral lipstick to her lips. Simultaneously, <Subject 2> reaches up to adjust the collar of her olive jacket. The two women catch each other's gaze and share a genuine laugh as the wind lifts their hair. The camera moves with a playful, quick handheld drift, emphasizing the intimate and candid nature of the moment.
